units.source: Sorting the selection is experimental, and it changes as it matures. To use it, turn on __TRILIUM_PH_0__Sort selection in text editor__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Options__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Advanced__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Experimental Options__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
Trilium can sort the items of a list, a group of paragraphs or the rows of a table in a text note, comparing numbers, dates and times by their value.

To sort, place the cursor in a list or a table, or select the paragraphs to sort, then press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Sort__TRILIUM_PH_2__ button of the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_4__ to sort in ascending order. The arrow beside it offers __TRILIUM_PH_5__Ascending__TRILIUM_PH_6__ and __TRILIUM_PH_7__Descending__TRILIUM_PH_8__. With the floating toolbar, the button is in the block-level popup.

When the selection covers several paragraphs, list items or table cells, the same choices are also in a submenu of the menu of the block handle (the sequence of dots to the left of the block), just above __TRILIUM_PH_0__Delete__TRILIUM_PH_1__, and in the right-click menu of the selection. The submenu is named after what it sorts: __TRILIUM_PH_2__Sort blocks__TRILIUM_PH_3__, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Sort list items__TRILIUM_PH_5__ or __TRILIUM_PH_6__Sort rows__TRILIUM_PH_7__.
On the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the button is in the main row of the toolbar and in the row of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__List ›__TRILIUM_PH_3__ button.
A sort can be undone with __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Z__TRILIUM_PH_3__.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__List items__TRILIUM_PH_1__: with the cursor in a list, the items at its level are sorted. Nested items move with the item they belong to and keep their own order. To sort only some of the items, select them.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Paragraphs and other blocks__TRILIUM_PH_1__: select two or more paragraphs, headings, quotes, collapsible blocks or images. Each block is sorted by its first text: a collapsible block by its title, a quote by its first paragraph and an image by its caption. A selection that mixes a list with other blocks cannot be sorted.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__Table rows__TRILIUM_PH_1__: the rows are sorted by the column of the cursor, as described in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Sorting rows__TRILIUM_PH_3__ in __TRILIUM_PH_4__Tables__TRILIUM_PH_5__. Inside a table cell, a list or several selected paragraphs are sorted instead of the rows.
Values are compared the same way as table rows, see __TRILIUM_PH_0__How values are compared__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Tables__TRILIUM_PH_3__.

The lines of a code block, or of a paragraph split with __TRILIUM_PH_0__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_3__, are not sorted one by one. A __TRILIUM_PH_4__Code__TRILIUM_PH_5__ note can sort its lines, see __TRILIUM_PH_6__Transforming text__TRILIUM_PH_7__ there.
